Time-shift invariance by one delay gives identical current and delayed marginals, so the mean is exactly \(K_\delta\) and the lag covariance is zero. The pointwise per-capita growth equation then gives the exact variance/activity identity. Zero variance makes every future current evaluation equal to \(K_\delta\); the delay equation then propagates constancy through the initial history, proving the equilibrium equality class. The packaged exact checker independently verifies all algebraic reductions.

value.rationale: The delay \(\tau\) is the defining biological feedback timescale of the Hutchinson–Wright model, so exact zero covariance at precisely that lag is a natural and directly observable invariant rather than an arbitrary statistic. The mean-locking law proves that proportional harvesting lowers the stationary mean exactly and independently of oscillation amplitude, ruling out a stationary-mean hydra effect within this classical model. The activity identity converts population variance into mean-square per-capita growth with a parameter-exact factor. Together these provide exact consistency checks for periodic or simulated delayed-logistic regimes and sharpen a same-model numerical observation about average population.
